package.name: rclrs_image_transport
package.description:
The half of image_transport that rclrs cannot reach.
image_transport is a C++ pluginlib system: a Rust node cannot load its plugins, and rclrs has no intra-process comms either, so the Rust side has to own both the JPEG codec and the image/camera_info pairing. This package is that, and nothing golf-cart specific is in it -- it is meant to be extracted into its own repository under NEWSLabNTU once it has settled.
The contract it implements is CompressedImage.format as compressed_image_transport writes and reads it. See docs/roadmaps/2-camera-image-pipeline.md sub-phase C.
